summary: The audit checks the didactic courses (Foundations of Clinical Medicine and of Clinical Pharmacology, Clinical Anatomy, and the Pathophysiology, Practice of Medicine, Clinical Pharmacology and Therapeutics, and LEAD-PA series), the twelve 6-unit clerkships, and 182 units in all. Both the old and new numbers count for the two series being renumbered. Checked by hand: the leadership track and thesis, the milestone examinations and the annual survey.

apRHQlpY.why: "Beginning in AY 26-27, this course series is being renamed/renumbered from Principles of Clinical Medicine (PAS 212-215) to Pathophysiology and Clinical Medicine (PAS 232-235). This change has taken effect for the first two courses in the series; the latter two courses will be changed prior to AY 27-28." Either number fills each slot.

YLlrqf4n.why: "Beginning in AY 26-27, this course series is being renamed/renumbered from Clinical Therapeutics (PAS 222-225) to Clinical Pharmacology and Therapeutics (PAS 242-245). This change has taken effect for the first two courses in the series". Either number fills each slot.

CTuOxUZ4.why: "Beyond the core curriculum and clerkships, students are required to select a leadership track and complete a thesis ... Each student must declare a Leadership Track by submitting their course plan ... A final complete Thesis paper is due at the end of Q8 (December)." The track coursework is not listed.

CXM2k5m6.why: "All MSPA students are required to complete and pass the following milestone examinations: End of Didactic Exam (EOD) ... CPX-P ... APSA/PRISM ... End of Curriculum Exam (EOC)"

Coy9R9Ye.why: "It is a milestone requirement for MSPA students to complete the MSPA Program Annual Survey"
